cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Talk Around the Mess
cards.instruction: Keep attention on minor details so no one addresses the larger responsibility you avoided.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm coordinating the move. Blue labels for these boxes, unless you feel strongly about green.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're empty. You were supposed to pack the kitchen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The system comes first. Green, if that's easier. Help me choose where the labels go so we're working together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The van's here. The driver is coming up to load them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, we can involve him before I finalize the system. Ask whether he wants the labels on the top or side. I'll go with his preference.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 make actual task and deadline plain; A shifts their practical concern into consultation.

heightening.evidence: A5 expands the unproductive detail meeting to the arriving person who needs packed boxes.
